commands: echo "ACTIONS=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-unset}"; echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-unset}"; git branch --show-current; git status --short | head; git log --oneline -3

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp; gh issue view 1271 --json body --jq '.body' > .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1271.md 2>/dev/null || { mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/issue-body && gh issue view 1271 --json body --jq '.body' > .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1271.md; }; .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/parse-acs.py --body-file .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1271.md > .prflow/tmp/acs-1271.md; echo "===ACS==="; cat .prflow/tmp/acs-1271.md
mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/issue-body; gh issue view 1271 --json body --jq '.body' > .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1271.md; wc -l .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1271.md

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/workpad.py update 1271 --status Implementing --tick-progress "Setup" --replace-plan-file /dev/stdin --note "Phase 1 complete; base main; deps PROCEED" <<'EOF' 2>&1 | tail -3
- [ ] Add `scripts/decide-verdict-gap-job-status.sh`: 3-arg helper (ARM, REVIEW_CLASS, CANCELLED) → FAIL/PASS token, always exit 0; header states oracle residual, cancellation vacuous-premise, is_error + no-output-fallback dispositions, and every could-not-tell arm
- [ ] Wire the helper into dev …[per-command-truncated]

chmod +x scripts/decide-verdict-gap-job-status.sh
echo "--- basic drive ---"
for arm in reached not-reached unestablished no-line unrecognized-line garbage; do
  for rc in "none" "marked" "unmarked 42" "unestablished payload-unreadable" ""; do
    for c in true false; do
      out=$(bash scripts/decide-verdict-gap-job-status.sh "$arm" "$rc" "$c")
      printf 'arm=%-16s rc=%-28s cancelled=%-5s -> %s\n' "$arm" "$rc" "$c" "$out"
    done
  done
done | grep -E 'FAIL|cancelled=true' | head -40
ls .changeset/ 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---sample---"; f=$(ls .changeset/*.md 2>/dev/null | grep -v README | head -1); echo "$f"; cat "$f" 2>/dev/null
for f in scripts/check-verdict-post-reached.sh scripts/describe-verdict-post-gap.sh scripts/classify-head-reviews.sh; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; done

TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/1271/comments?per_page=100" --jq 'map(select((.body | contains("/prflow:implement")) and ((.body | test("(pr|dev)flow:workpad")) | not))) | last | .id' 2>/dev/null || true); echo "trigger=$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID"; if [ -n "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID" ] && [ -z "${TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID//[0-9]/}" ]; then .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/react-to-trigger.sh --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --event issue_comment --comment "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID" --reaction hooray --r …[per-command-truncated]

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
